        terms = []

                ay = a_list[y_index - 1]
                # Fraction: (ax*ay - 1) / (ax - ay)

                denominator = ax - ay

                terms.append(numerator / denominator)
        
        result = 1

    A2 += product_term(2, [a1, a2, a3])
    A2 += product_term(3, [a1, a2, a3])
    
    return A2
